theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder α] [Add α] [Sub α] [OrderedSub α] [Preorder β] [Add β] [Sub β] [OrderedSub β] (f : α →ₙ+ β) (hf : Monotone ⇑f) (a b : α) : f a - f b ≤ f (a - b) := by
  have h1 : a - b ≤ a := by exact sub_le_left_iff.1 (le_refl a)
  have h2 : f (a - b) ≤ f a := by exact hf h1
  have h3 : f a - f b ≤ f a := by exact sub_le_self f a f b
  have h4 : f a - f b ≤ f (a - b) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    apply add_le_left
    exact h2
  exact h4
